nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Activation calls setWebhook for @medspa_frontdesk_bot with this node's URL (/webhook/<webhookId>/webhook). A bot has exactly one webhook: never activate a second workflow with a Telegram Trigger on the MedSpa Telegram credential.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: Returns [] (the run ends) for anything that is not a private Telegram chat or a WhatsApp message: groups, WhatsApp status callbacks, unknown bodies. Never emits an empty contact_id.

nodes.name: Rate Limit
nodes.notes: 10-minute window, 20 messages per contact, kept in this workflow's static data (saved only by production runs of the active workflow). notify is true exactly once, on message 21.

nodes.name: Notify Spam
nodes.notes: Both outputs go to Send Rate Limit: the client is told about the pause even if the owner alert failed.

value.text: ={{ '⛔ Rate limit: ' + $json.contact_id + ' sent 21 messages in 10 minutes; paused' }}

nodes.name: New Client?
nodes.notes: A new contact gets its Clients row here, on the first message, so every tool (propose_booking included) finds a client row.

nodes.name: Detect Language
nodes.notes: Continue on error: a failed detection gives an item without text, and Create Client then stores language en.

parameters.text:
=Identify the language of the message below. Reply with only its ISO 639-1 code, for example en, de, es, ru. If unsure, reply en.

Message: {{ $('Normalize').first().json.text }}

nodes.name: Client Data
nodes.notes: Reached from New Client? false (the found Clients record) or from Create Client (the new record); both are {id, fields}.

nodes.name: Classify
nodes.notes: Deterministic: kind is yes or no only when the WHOLE short message (up to 3 words, please removed) is a known yes/no word.

nodes.name: Gate
nodes.notes: confirm: a bare YES with a pending proposal. llm: a short non-yes/no message with a pending proposal (Haiku decides). reminder: everything else goes through Reminder Check first, so a YES/NO to a reminder reaches reminder_reply; a bare YES with no reminder then goes to Confirm (ALREADY_BOOKED or NO_PENDING -> Agent).

nodes.name: LLM Affirmative
nodes.notes: Continue on error: a failed call gives an item without text, Affirmative? is false and the message goes on to Reminder Check and the agent.

parameters.text:
=The assistant asked the user to reply YES to confirm a booking. Does the following user message mean agreement or confirmation? Reply with exactly YES or NO.

Message: {{ $('Client Data').first().json.text }}

nodes.name: Confirm
nodes.notes: confirm_booking writes the calendar. Error output (it throws on a real calendar failure) -> Notify Failure -> Send Error.

value.vars_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ alternatives: $json.alternatives || 'none in the next days' }) }}

nodes.name: No Reminded?
nodes.notes: NO_REMINDED has no visit, so the template would have nothing to fill and send_message would throw: the message is an ordinary one for the agent.

nodes.name: Bare Yes?
nodes.notes: A bare YES with no pending proposal and no reminder to answer: confirm_booking decides (ALREADY_BOOKED for a booked visit, NO_PENDING -> Agent).

nodes.name: Agent
nodes.notes: Error output -> Notify Failure -> Send Error: the client always gets an answer.

nodes.name: Notify Failure
nodes.notes: Reached from the error output of Confirm, Reminder Reply or Agent. Both outputs go to Send Error: the client is answered even if the owner alert failed.

value.text: ={{ '❌ Reply failed for ' + $('Client Data').first().json.contact_id + ': ' + String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || $json.error)) || 'see WF-6').slice(0, 300) + ' (step: ' + $prevNode.name + '; the client got the ERROR message)' }}

nodes.name: Fresh Pending
nodes.notes: A pending row whose summary was not sent yet = the agent just proposed a booking. Continue on error: a failed read sends the agent's own reply instead of nothing.

nodes.name: Send Summary
nodes.notes: The summary is built from the Appointments row (service, duration, time), not from the agent's text.

nodes.name: Notify Send Failure
nodes.notes: A send itself failed: only the owner can be told. Error output deliberately unconnected (nothing else left to try).

value.text: ={{ '❌ Could not send a message to ' + $('Normalize').first().json.contact_id + ' (step: ' + $prevNode.name + '): ' + String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || $json.error)) || 'see WF-6').slice(0, 300) + '. Their message: ' + String($('Normalize').first().json.text || '(not text)').slice(0, 200) }}
